definitions.explanation: The formal closing of a meeting, session, conference, ceremony, or similar gathering. Used for official or structured events — Diet sessions, conferences, sports tournaments, academic symposia — rather than casual gatherings. Often paired with its opposite, {開会|かいかい} ('opening').

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{閉会|へいかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{閉会|へいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}した→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧。
examples.english: The chair declared the meeting closed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{閉会式|へいかいしき}→閉会式：26936_heikaishiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われます→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The closing ceremony of the tournament will be held next Sunday.

notes:
Compound of {閉|へい} ('close; shut') and ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ ('meeting'). Refers specifically to the formal closing of a structured event and carries an institutional or ceremonial tone.

USAGE:
- Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {閉会|へいかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to close the meeting').
- Common in news reports, official announcements, and formal speeches — rarely in casual conversation about ending a chat or party.
- The opposite is ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧ ('opening'); the two often appear together in ceremony names: ⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧ / ⟦{閉会式|へいかいしき}→閉会式：26936_heikaishiki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉会|へいかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adjourned; to close a meeting
- {閉会|へいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}する→宣言する：21680_sengensuru⟧: to declare the meeting closed
- ⟦{閉会式|へいかいしき}→閉会式：26936_heikaishiki⟧: closing ceremony
- {閉会|へいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: closing remarks
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{閉会|へいかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the Diet session closes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧: opening (of a meeting) — the direct opposite.
- ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: end; conclusion — more general, used for any event, program, or activity ending.
- ⟦{散会|さんかい}→散会：24772_sankai⟧: breaking up of a meeting — emphasizes participants dispersing rather than formal closing.
- ⟦{閉幕|へいまく}→閉幕：08175_heimaku⟧: closing (of an event) — more theatrical or ceremonial in tone, originally 'lowering the curtain'.
